=== Web Server Config ===
##
# arelogic.space — Wasd monorepo (active deployment path: /root/opt/areloria)
# Managed by Emergent VPS setup. Domain DNS currently via Cloudflare.
# Upstream Node service runs via PM2 (process: areloria) on 127.0.0.1:3000.
# Static client/dist is served as fallback if the upstream is unreachable.
##

upstream wasd_areloria_upstream {
    server 127.0.0.1:3000 max_fails=3 fail_timeout=10s;
    keepalive 32;
}

# --- HTTP (port 80) ---
# Serves content directly (safe for Cloudflare "Flexible" SSL mode) and also
# redirects direct-IP/non-proxied traffic via Cloudflare. Redirect handled at
# Cloudflare edge when in Full/Full-Strict mode.
server {
    listen 80;
    listen [::]:80;
    server_name arelogic.space www.arelogic.space;

    # ACME renewal support
    location /.well-known/acme-challenge/ {
        root /var/www/html;
    }

    location / {
        return 301 https://$host$request_uri;
    }
}

server {
    listen 443 ssl http2;
    listen [::]:443 ssl http2;
    server_name arelogic.space;

    ssl_certificate     /etc/letsencrypt/live/arelogic.space-0001/fullchain.pem;
    ssl_certificate_key /etc/letsencrypt/live/arelogic.space-0001/privkey.pem;
    include /etc/letsencrypt/options-ssl-nginx.conf;
    ssl_dhparam /etc/letsencrypt/ssl-dhparams.pem;

    # Real IP from Cloudflare (safe: only trusts CF ranges)
    real_ip_header CF-Connecting-IP;
    real_ip_recursive on;

    client_max_body_size 50M;
    gzip on;
    gzip_types text/plain text/css application/javascript application/json image/svg+xml;

    # Static fallback root (used only when upstream is down)
    root /root/opt/areloria/client/dist;
    index index.html;

    # Server-level fallback for upstream failures (connection refused, timeouts, 5xx)
    error_page 502 503 504 = @static_fallback;

    # --- Primary: proxy to Node app on :3000 (Wasd server) ---
    location / {
        proxy_pass http://wasd_areloria_upstream;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
        proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
        proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade";
        proxy_read_timeout 90s;
        proxy_connect_timeout 5s;
        proxy_intercept_errors on;
        proxy_next_upstream error timeout http_502 http_503 http_504;
    }

    # Websocket endpoint (explicit path if app uses /socket.io)
    location /socket.io/ {
        proxy_pass http://wasd_areloria_upstream;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
        proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade";
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_read_timeout 3600s;
    }

    # --- Static SPA fallback (used when upstream is down) ---
    location @static_fallback {
        internal;
        root /root/opt/areloria/client/dist;
        rewrite ^ /index.html break;
        add_header X-Served-By "nginx-static-fallback" always;
    }

    # Health endpoint (nginx-local, no upstream)
    location = /nginx-health {
        access_log off;
        default_type text/plain;
        return 200 "ok\n";
    }
}

upstream arelorian_upstream {
    server 127.0.0.1:3000 max_fails=3 fail_timeout=10s;
    keepalive 32;
}

server {
    listen 443 ssl http2;
    listen [::]:443 ssl http2;
    server_name arelorian.de www.arelorian.de;

    ssl_certificate     /etc/letsencrypt/live/arelorian.de/fullchain.pem;
    ssl_certificate_key /etc/letsencrypt/live/arelorian.de/privkey.pem;
    ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;

    client_max_body_size 50M;
    gzip on;
    gzip_types text/plain text/css application/javascript application/json image/svg+xml;

    # Static SPA root (used as fallback when backend on :3000 is down)
    root /root/opt/areloria/client/dist;
    index index.html;

    # On upstream failure -> serve static SPA
    error_page 502 503 504 = @static_fallback;

    location / {
        proxy_pass http://arelorian_upstream;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
        proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
        proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade";
        proxy_read_timeout 90s;
        proxy_connect_timeout 5s;
        proxy_intercept_errors on;
        proxy_next_upstream error timeout http_502 http_503 http_504;
    }

    location /socket.io/ {
        proxy_pass http://arelorian_upstream;
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
        proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade";
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_read_timeout 3600s;
    }

    location @static_fallback {
        internal;
        root /root/opt/areloria/client/dist;
        try_files $uri /index.html =404;
        add_header X-Served-By "nginx-static-fallback" always;
    }

    location = /nginx-health {
        access_log off;
        default_type text/plain;
        return 200 "ok\n";
    }
}
